Acclaimed “go-live” of the application.

Management, Internal and external Payments.
Perform tie-outs and true-ups for monthly and quarterly accounts, ensuring timely statement approval. Monitor and manage client accounts, including financial transactions and service
usage.
Interact with clients for MIS reporting via emails and conference calls.
